why: Haiku read only the abstract and never formulated the ES semi-integral question. Doing so is cheap: Thm 2.15 applies verbatim (same boundary triangle as Markoff), strict Darmon-2 points are solutions of ES_{nq²} with the q-part in one coordinate, abundant for n ≥ 2, and at n = 1 they are exactly the Type I solutions of odd squares (empty by T1) while Campana points exist. That is a nontrivial calibration, though not an ES lead.
